Washing Machine X9 Release Notes
SEPTEMBER 18, 2026 AT 10:50 PM

This article provides a list of historical release notes for publicly released versions of Intego's Washing Machine X9 software. Be sure to keep your software up to date by using the NetUpdate application.

Download the latest version of Washing Machine X9

 

10.9.28

Release Date: March 24th, 2026

• Security Update: Fixed a local privilege escalation vulnerability involving XPC communication. This version reinforces security by implementing strict Audit Token validation to securely identify communicating processes.

Shared Components Update:

• Version: Common Services 10.9.44 | Release Date: March 23rd, 2026

• Version: NetUpdate 10.9.40 | Release Date: March 23rd, 2026

This update is compatible with macOS Tahoe.

 
10.9.27

Release Date: September 10th, 2025

Updates for all X9 products have been pushed to NetUpdate. All those updates brings compatibility with Tahoe.

This update applies new icons matching Apple’s guideline for Tahoe. Those new icons will appear on all versions of macOS.

This update is compatible with macOS Tahoe.

 
10.9.26  (1273)

Release Date:November 4th, 2024

• Resolves an issue where the Washing Machine icon may not appear in the Full Disk Access list in System Settings. 

This update improves overall stability, supports general compatibility issues, and addresses a number of other minor issues.

This version is compatible with macOS Sonoma.
